wx_snow.bake.already: Something is already running (bake or test).
wx_snow.bake.failed: Roof map bake failed, see the debug log.
wx_snow.bake.not_running: The roof map bake is not running.

wx_snow.bake.stopped: Roof map bake paused at tile {tile}. /snowbake start {tile} continues.
wx_snow.bake.uploaded: Roof map sent to the server.
wx_snow.cmd.cover_set: Ground coverage fixed at {coverage}% (only you). /snow reset to go back.
wx_snow.cmd.debug_on: Debug view on: red road, orange pavement, green soft ground, teal foliage, blue other, purple under a roof, yellow indoor zone.
wx_snow.cmd.global_reset: Override removed, back to the weekly event (level {level}).
wx_snow.cmd.global_set: Snow level {level} for everybody until /snow global reset or the next week.

wx_snow.cmd.preview_reset: Preview off, you see the server's snow again.
wx_snow.cmd.preview_set: Preview (only you): level {level} - {name}. /snow reset to go back.

wx_snow.test.failed: Snow test failed, see the debug log.

wx_snow.test.started: Snow test '{kind}' started. /snowtest stop ends it.
